notes: Puretip One 2.03, now published by Augeas Technologies. Installs as the new Augeas app, then offers to remove the old one; your tip profiles are kept. If this tablet starts the app on boot, set it as the Home app again in Diagnostics. Includes the V2.0 station software: pulsed misting and cleaning with cycle counts, Flush Mode, RS232 link, firmware updates, and fault alarms that chime until acknowledged.
